# Hit Recently condition (Preserver of Eternity / Injury Buffer / Deflection lines)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** condition, trigger, ui-display

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Modeled as a user boolean toggle (`recently_hit` in `data/conditions.json`), matched from gear/spirit text reading "(haven't/have not) been hit recently" or "have been hit recently". Distinct from `recently_taken_damage`: per the Help Database's Chance to Avoid Damage entry, an avoided hit is still deemed a successful hit (the attacker's hit-related effects still trigger), so "hit" and "damage taken" are separate game states. This does NOT extend to Evade — its Help Database entry states the opposite (on-hit effects and damage are not inflicted when a hit is evaded), so an evaded attack is not a "hit" at all. Lines using the "hit recently" phrasing: Preserver of Eternity's Movement Speed line (pact spirit), the SS12 ethereal-prism Injury Buffer line, and SS13 Deflection lines (belt blends / legendary gear / marksman). Only the Preserver of Eternity Movement Speed line is currently wired to a stat contribution — the others are recognized by the condition parser but not yet consumed by any engine stat. The in-game duration window that counts as "recently" is NOT sourced anywhere in the above — no number should be stated for it; that window is the thing to verify in-game.
